title: YEEZY 500
description: The 2023 edition of the adidas Yeezy 500 ‘Bone White’ revives a subdued colorway of the retro-inspired model. An ivory finish floods the upper, composed of airy mesh with durable overlays in suede and leather. A seamless rubber mudguard offers improved support and abrasion resistance, while reflective piping around the eyestay provides improved visibility in low-light conditions. Lightweight cushioning arrives via an adiPRENE+ midsole, featuring podular construction that takes its cues from the adidas KB8 3.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANT
description: Developed by Kanye West, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 sneaker realizes the designer's usual subversive style. This edition—launched in July 2019—features a bicolor Primeknit bootie, integrated rope laces and tonal collar piping. A monofilament stripe runs the length of the lateral side and the signature heel strap has been excluded. Encased Boost technology with a semi-translucent rubber sole unit supports first steps.

title: YEEZY BOOST 700
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 ‘Enflame Amber’ features muted earth tones on the upper, constructed from breathable beige mesh with dark brown suede overlays throughout the midfoot. A tonal beige toe cap reinforces an unexpected pop of blue mesh on the toe box. Responsive cushioning arrives via a full-length drop-in Boost midsole, housed within a coral-hued EVA carrier and made visible through cut-out detailing on the herringbone-traction rubber outsole.
